title: WIP: Wasteland Renegades, attract mode
author: KingofKingsofKingsof
selftext: WIP as of October 28 2026. New name so as not to be confused with Wasteland Warriors. New cars added. Added a 'how to play' attract mode. Getting near to release ready.  Probably need to add a boss as the boss fight is currently just loads of cars to fight. Difficulty will need to be tweaked. I can complete it on easy, but not normal of hard yet.  Will be looking for play testers at some point, likely on [Itch.io](http://Itch.io) at first. Would love to get this on Steam and then play store, but only if people think this is worth it and looks fun
